title.narrative: Scaling up quality HIV case cascade through community engagement and addressing human rights barriers - Ghana (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Ghana, HIV, Ghana-West Africa Program to Combat AIDS - STI (WAPCAS)This program has the following goals: To achieve HIV epidemic control and the fast track treatment targets of 90-90-90 by 2023. To reduce new HIV infections by 42% by 2023. The objectives of this program are: To increase the estimated PLHIV who know their status from 58% in 2019 to 90% by 2023.. To increase the % of people newly diagnosed with HIV initiated on ART from 81% in 2019 to 95% in 2023. To increase the % of HIV-positive women who received ART during pregnancy and/or labour and delivery from 75% in 2019 to 95% in 2023. To increase the % of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth from 65% in 2019 to 90% in 2023. To increase the % of PLHIV on ART who initiated TB preventive therapy among those eligible during the reporting period to 49% in 2023. To increase ART initiation among HIV-positive KP (MSM) and (FSW) to 95% in 2023. To increase the % of clients on ART who are virally suppressed from 68% in 2019 to 90% by 2023.. To increase comprehensive HIV & AIDS knowledge among KP to 70% in 2023
